subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun 8/16 shortlist | Unity Software leads a large-cap-heavy week (7 candidates)
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Shortlist

Sunday, August 16, 2026 — Kuwait time

7 candidates cleared all gates

Best fresh setup: Unity Software (U) — still accelerating off its Aug 6 earnings gap on heavy volume. Large caps dominated this scan (EXPE, STX, ZBRA all near/at 52-week highs); small-cap breakouts mostly failed live confirmation — see cuts below.

~28 raw tickers surfaced across 25 web searches + IBKR theme discovery. 7 survived Gate 1–4 (live signal, liquidity/sizing, halal/defense, extension check). 2 of those 7 are flagged WAIT FOR PULLBACK — don't chase them at Friday's close. 20 candidates were cut; reasons listed at the bottom.

#1 — U Unity Software Inc.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) Software MID CAP 		$46.20 +0.90%

Signal: Gapped +15% on Aug 6 on 28.3M shares (~5x normal volume) — earnings beat/guide-up. Has made a fresh incremental high nearly every session since; today's $46.25 high is another new high, 8 trading days into the move.

Why it's interesting: Textbook post-earnings drift — the binary event is behind it, volume confirms institutional participation, and the stock hasn't given back a single day since the gap. Up 175% off its 52-week low with room before the old 52w high ($60.87).

Realistic near-term target: +6% to $49 over 3-6 trading days — next round-number resistance; +12% to $52 if continuation holds.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET

Order plan (GTC):
BUY limit $46.25 · stop-limit trigger $44.90 / limit $44.60 (below Aug 14 low $45.15) · TP1 sell limit $49.00 · TP2 $52.00
Size ~1.77 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 1.7:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — game engine/dev tools software   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze U
#2 — EXPE Expedia Group Inc.
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) Consumer/Travel LARGE CAP 		$332.00 +1.12%

Signal: Gapped up on a late-July earnings beat and has made a new high in 8 of the last 10 sessions — a clean, low-volatility grind, not a spike. Closed today exactly at its 52-week high.

Why it's interesting: Steady relative-strength leadership with an ascending base underneath (each daily low higher than the last) — the kind of controlled trend that's easy to protect with a tight stop.

Realistic near-term target: +3.8% to $345 (round-number extension), +8% to $360 if trend continues.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET

Order plan (GTC):
BUY limit $332.50 · stop-limit trigger $327.00 / limit $325.50 (below Aug 14 low $327.87) · TP1 sell limit $345.00 · TP2 $360.00
Size ~0.247 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 1.8:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — travel booking/facilitation, no alcohol sold directly   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: requires fractional shares — confirm enabled before entering.

Next step: analyze EXPE
#3 — PLSE Pulse Biosciences Inc.
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) Medtech SMALL CAP 		$44.54 -0.85%

Signal: Gapped from $38.24 to $42.41 on Aug 7 (heavy volume breakout), pushed to a fresh 52-week high of $46.97 on Aug 13, now consolidating with a tight rising base ($40.68 → $43.75 over the last 5 sessions).

Why it's interesting: Electroporation medical device maker (cardiac ablation) — clean small-cap breakout that's held its gains for a week rather than spiking and fading same-day.

Realistic near-term target: +5.4% to $47 (retest of the Aug 13 high), +12% to $50 on continuation.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET

Order plan (GTC):
BUY limit $44.60 · stop-limit trigger $43.50 / limit $43.20 (below Aug 14 low $43.78) · TP1 sell limit $47.00 · TP2 $50.00
Size ~1.84 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 1.7:1

Event window: No known dated catalyst pending ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — medical device manufacturer   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: avg daily $ volume ~$16M — thinner than the rest of this list; fine for an $82 clip but don't scale this one up.

Next step: analyze PLSE
#4 — STX Seagate Technology Holdings
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) AI/Data Center LARGE CAP 		$974.00 +5.71%

Signal: Ripped from ~$800 to $974 in 4 sessions (Aug 10→14, +22%) on AI/data-center storage demand — the freshest, strongest move on this list.

Why it's interesting: Real theme, real volume — but a 22% four-day sprint means the stop has to sit far below to stay valid, which breaks the risk/reward at today's price. This is the Gate 4 case: correct thesis, bad entry if chased.

Realistic near-term target: +5-8% from a pulled-back entry, not from here.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $920-935 — do not chase at $974.

Order plan (GTC, if pullback fills):
BUY limit $930.00 · stop-limit trigger $915.00 / limit $912.00 (below Aug 14 low $920) · TP1 sell limit $980.00 · TP2 $1030.00
Size ~0.088 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 2.8:1 (vs. ~1:1 if bought at market today)

Event window: No dated catalyst pending ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — data storage hardware   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze STX (re-check before the pullback order fills — this one moves fast)
#5 — THC Tenet Healthcare Corp.
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Healthcare MID CAP 		$267.90 +0.32%

Signal: Broke out hard on a late-July earnings beat (~$195 → $233 in one session) and has kept grinding to new highs since, including a fresh 52-week high of $270.57 on Aug 13.

Why it's interesting: For-profit hospital operator riding sustained relative strength three weeks after the initial catalyst — a slower, more mature version of the same post-earnings-drift setup as U and EXPE.

Realistic near-term target: +3.8% to $278, +6.4% to $285.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET

Order plan (GTC):
BUY limit $267.90 · stop-limit trigger $263.50 / limit $262.00 (below Aug 13 low $264.65) · TP1 sell limit $278.00 · TP2 $285.00
Size ~0.306 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 1.7:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — hospital operator   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: requires fractional shares — confirm enabled before entering.

Next step: analyze THC
#6 — ZBRA Zebra Technologies Corp.
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) Enterprise Hardware LARGE CAP 		$374.05 -1.47%

Signal: Massive Aug 4 earnings gap (+26% in a day, $292→$369) followed by continued highs through Aug 11-13 (52w high $386.23); pulling back slightly the last two sessions.

Why it's interesting: Barcode/RFID enterprise tech name with a rare one-day 26% earnings pop that's held almost all its gains — the pullback is normal digestion, not a breakdown, as long as it stays above this week's lows.

Realistic near-term target: +3.2% to $386 (retest of the high), +7% to $400.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET

Order plan (GTC):
BUY limit $374.00 · stop-limit trigger $369.00 / limit $367.00 (below Aug 14 low $371.10) · TP1 sell limit $386.00 · TP2 $400.00
Size ~0.219 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 1.7:1

Event window: Earnings already behind it ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — enterprise hardware/software   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Sizing note: requires fractional shares — confirm enabled before entering.

Next step: analyze ZBRA
#7 — RVMD Revolution Medicines Inc.
⭐⭐ (2/5) Biotech LARGE CAP 		$203.71 +0.85%

Signal: Ran from ~$183 to a 52-week high of $208.77 on Aug 10, then pulled back for 4 sessions to $203.71 — consolidating just under the high, not breaking down.

Why it's interesting: Oncology biotech (up 475% off its 52-week low) with a real, already-fired move — but buying here means risking more to a valid stop than the distance back to the old high offers. Weakest score on this list; only included because the base is real.

Realistic near-term target: +4.25% to $208.50 from a pulled-back entry.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $199-201 — R:R is poor buying at today's $203.71.

Order plan (GTC, if pullback fills):
BUY limit $200.00 · stop-limit trigger $197.00 / limit $196.00 (below Aug 14 low $198.89) · TP1 sell limit $208.50 · TP2 $215.00
Size ~0.41 sh ≈ $82 (~15%) · R:R to TP1 ≈ 2.1:1

Event window: No dated catalyst pending ✅   Halal: ✅ Verified — oncology therapeutics   Defense check: ✅ Clear

Next step: analyze RVMD

🏆 Today's best setup

U — Unity Software. Highest conviction score on the list (5/5): fresh new highs today, confirmed by a 5x-normal volume spike on the original breakout day, still trending with no down day since the gap. R:R at market is the cleanest of the seven. Invalidation: a close back below $44.90 (the Aug 14 low) — that's the stop reference, not a percentage guess.

Cut this run — 20 candidates, with reasons

FADED vs. live IBKR data (search said bullish, price says otherwise):
AMAT — JPM raised PT to $660 but stock was down 5.2% today and 31% off its 52w high, selling off hard.
CELH — heavy call activity noted, but stock is 56% off its 52-week high, no confirmed uptrend.
FUN (Six Flags) — unusual options flow flagged, but stock is near 52-week lows and red on the day.
MBC (MasterBrand) — insider buying cluster noted, but stock is 35% off highs and red today; hasn't shown up in price yet.
UTHR — heavy call volume from Aug 6 (stale), stock essentially flat and 18% off highs.
OKLO — nuclear/SMR momentum story is stale for this name specifically: 77% off its 52-week high, red today.
NNE — same nuclear theme issue: 68% off its 52-week high, red today.

Data-insufficient:
NVTS — IBKR returned zero live volume and no 52-week stats for this contract; couldn't confirm the "91% YTD" search claim with live data, so it's dropped rather than passed through unconfirmed.

Excluded — strategy/halal/defense rules:
CAPR — this is the exact name that stopped Abbas out for -$234.73 on Jul 27, two days before its Aug 22 AdCom. Binary-catalyst trading on this name is explicitly paused per decisions.md — skip regardless of this week's analyst upgrade.
AXON — halal fail: core product line includes tasers/stun guns (weapons manufacturing).
PLTR (Palantir) — despite a strong August move, core business is DoD/intelligence-agency data contracts; treated as defense-adjacent under the personal exclusion even though it's software, not hardware.
GS, TRV, SOFI, COF — halal fail: conventional banking/insurance/consumer lending as primary business.

Weak/ambiguous signal — cut on quality, not excluded outright:
CRDO, VRT — both red today and well off highs; no fresh confirming move this week, just riding a semis/data-center pullback.
STRL — bounced +4.3% today but is still 42% off its 52-week high; can't tell if that's a genuine reversal or a bounce inside a longer downtrend.
FIX — sharp selloff in late July it hasn't fully recovered from; still 14% below its 13-week high, choppy rather than trending.
DELL — current price is already within ~4% of the freshly-raised analyst target, leaving little room for the trade.
CEG — +1.4% today is modest, and the stock is still 31% off its 52-week high; no fresh catalyst beyond the already-priced-in Calpine deal.
ALH — real but small analyst PT raise ($31→$32) on thin signal strength, no confirming price momentum.

Stale (outside the 5-trading-day freshness window):
CAT, AMZN, SHW, KO, Recruit Holdings (RCRUY) — moves are 1-3+ weeks old with no live continuation this week.

This shortlist is a first filter, not a buy signal. Run analyze [TICKER] on 1-2 names that interest you for the full fundamentals/event-risk deep dive before sizing a position. Size to leave room for 5-7 concurrent positions — don't let one name dominate the $546.58 in cash. Log any entry with the portfolio manager.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Prices and volume confirmed live via IBKR as of Friday, Aug 14 close (markets closed Sunday) — verify before placing GTC orders Monday. Verify halal compliance independently before entering. Generated Sun Aug 16 2026, Kuwait time.
